page.overview:
Who is Cruz Ramírez?

Cruz Ramirez is the deuteragonist ofCars 3.

She is described as "optimistic, sunny, fierce, and friendly,"

Cruz Ramírez was previously a fan of Lightning McQueen, who had inspired her to race, to the dismay of her overprotective family. Despite investing considerable time into practice and saving up for the race entry fee, the mere sight of other vehicles intimidated her into forfeiting. She never regained the courage to race again, and eventually began working under Sterling as a trainer for next-gen racers.

Cruz first seen coaching a few cars on the treadmills, and is initially mistaken by Lightning McQueen as a racer until Sterling corrects him. Once Cruz meets Lightning, despite her being a big fan of him as she grew up watching him on TV, she pokes fun of him for his age every chance she gets even referring to him as "[her] senior project").
